text: CI's adopter job builds an app that imports ArcaLaunch beside ArcaMasthead and ArcaLogConsole, with no ARCA_SWIFT_STRICT.

state.evidence: CI run 45765409791 (builtwitharca/arca_swift), attempt 1, at 940f91b5440b2ca5b280c9283a0164a884157426: adopter job success. Its adopter Package.swift takes ArcaMasthead, ArcaLogConsole and ArcaLaunch, and main.swift imports all three; the adopter job sets no ARCA_SWIFT_STRICT (ci.yml at 940f91b5). Read by vc and ic, 26 Nov.
